commit.message:
KAFKA-12861: Fix NPE in MockProducer.send() when serializers are null

The no-arg constructor MockProducer() creates the instance with
null key/value serializers. When send() is called for a topic
with no known partitions (e.g., Cluster.empty()), it attempts
serialization with the null serializers, causing an NPE.

Added null checks before calling keySerializer.serialize() and
valueSerializer.serialize() in the else branch of send().

This was a regression introduced by KAFKA-10503 when the
serialization path was added to the send method.

KAFKA-12861: Also fix NPE in partition() method and add tests

- Fix misleading comment in send() — serializers are now validated, not
  used to trigger ClassCastException
- Add null checks in partition() method (line 645) which also calls
  keySerializer.serialize() / valueSerializer.serialize() without guards
- Add testNoNpeWithDefaultConstructor: verifies no-arg constructor
  (null serializers, Cluster.empty()) does not NPE in send()
- Add testNoNpeInPartitionMethodWithNullSerializers: constructs a
  Cluster with actual partitions so partition() is really invoked
